The color used to represent 'Deutsch: ungedeckter Bedarf' is light blue, not light gray ('hellgrau').

The description of the legend omits the category for 'Andere Sprache: Nutzung' (dark purple).

errors.text_span: Der längste Balken für die deutsche Nutzungsquote für die Altersgruppe von zwei Jahren erreicht 92 %
errors.evidence: The value for the German usage rate ('Deutsch: Nutzung') for two-year-olds is 66%, not 92%. The value 92% corresponds to the German usage rate for three-year-olds.

errors.text_span: der höchste ungedeckte Bedarf für die deutsche Sprache bei der Altersgruppe von drei Jahren bei 97 %
errors.evidence: This statement is completely incorrect. The 'ungedeckter Bedarf für die deutsche Sprache' (unmet need for German) is represented by the light blue segment. For three-year-olds, this value is 4%. The highest value for this category across all ages is 25% (for one-year-olds). The value 97% corresponds to the German usage rate for four-year-olds.

errors.text_span: der niedrigste bei der Altersgruppe von Eins Jahren bei 66 % liegt
errors.evidence: This statement refers to the lowest 'ungedeckter Bedarf für die deutsche Sprache' (unmet need for German). For one-year-olds, this value is 25%, not 66%. The value 66% is the German usage rate for two-year-olds. The actual lowest value for unmet need in German is 0% for five-year-olds.
